items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I had played jobs with George, you know.

ctx.x: Yes. I had played jobs with George, you know. I didn't play study because I was busy with those other bands, you know. But I played lots of jobs with George when I couldn't play. Well, he'd get, there's a fellow by the name he called, Jose. You might have heard talking, Jose, a bass player. Well, he was playing.

Funnily enough, I heard of, you know who told me and mentioned his name? It was Emma George's wife. Emma, she, I was saying, who were the people that played over there, over the Lakers? Yeah. He said there was a man called Jose.
